business_summary: COSCO SHIPPING Energy Transportation Co., Ltd. (HKEX: 01138) is a Chinese H-share LNG and oil shipping group. Through wholly-owned CSLNG and 50%-owned China LNG Shipping (Holdings) Limited it had invested in 87 LNG carriers as of 31 December 2025 (63 in operation), and CLNG is named as a consortium partner on the QatarEnergy newbuilding programme this chain's lng-shipping-and-qatari-supply link tracks.
